div.head: ECf 18b
div.ab: Quodsi non poterit, exulabitur a patria.
div.note: Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 643 (November 2026): read from the page images and checked against the scan’s own text layer, differences settled against the page.

note.seg: Verf. meint nicht Ächtung Abwesender, also Landes-Abschwörung (s. 18, 2), und da Bürgen davon befreien, nicht den murdritor und traditor. Vgl. a. 1235: quia non potuit inuenire plegios, regnum abiurauit; Palgrave Rise II p. clxxxviii.

the author means not the outlawing of the absent, so abjuration of the realm (see 18, 2), and, since sureties free a man from that, not the murdritor and traditor. Cf. a. 1235: quia non potuit inuenire plegios, regnum abiurauit; Palgrave, Rise II p. clxxxviii.
